payload.body: One shape read for ST1c2db93's close sweep, item A 1.11, before cc banks (vc's ruling: a face under 744e, ic reads its shape once). The change is one hunk in intentsvcs/src/graphql.rs. Read it with: git -C tmp/wt-cc-sweep diff 7bbbe4135 -- native/rust/crates/intentsvcs/src/graphql.rs (cc's worktree; WIP ref refs/bank/cc/st1c2db93/sweep/wip-v1-on-7bbbe4135 = 5d4b45cbc, base 7bbbe4135). Snapshot::of now takes each thread through a new private fn listed(&Thread) -> Thread. listed puts the thread's criteria in Thread::criteria_in_order and its tests in Thread::tests_in_order, which is id::thread_label_order: the order acceptance.md, ac list, at list and the gate show. Before, the face gave them in the order the store loaded them. No field, type or SDL line changes; only the order inside the criteria and tests lists changes. No test reads it: no GraphQL test reads criteria or tests. Answer: agree, or the change you need.
